_comment: Three-component heterogeneous schedule (mlp_control periodic drone-control policy fp32 + dronet periodic int8 obstacle classifier + yolov8_nano non-periodic int8 object detector) profiled entirely on spike (scalar/rvv reference+curated kernels) rather than FireSim RTL -- a fast, no-hardware round trip through modelblaster + the XPU-RT scheduler. Mirrors networks_periodic_mlp10ms_dronet20ms_yolov8_firesim.json's network topology but with periods loosened to 100ms/150ms (from the original 10ms/20ms): yolov8_nano without gemmini acceleration is enormously slow on spike (600M-10.4B cycles, ~657ms non-periodic makespan at 1 instance each), so the original tight periods need ~66/33 periodic instances to converge -- correct, but a multi-minute greedy_periodic solve. Loosened periods keep this a fast pipeline-mechanics smoke test; use the original periods (see networks_periodic_mlp10ms_dronet20ms_yolov8_firesim.json) for a faithful reproduction once patient with the solver, or profile yolov8/dronet on gemmini to bring the makespan down instead. Profile data: gen/profile/{scalar,RVV}/spike/<model>/.../topo_0/results.csv (PROFILE_CPU=spike, PROFILE_CORES=0).
